source.title: earth :: a global map of wind, weather, and ocean conditions
source.creator: Cameron Beccario

rationale: Combines animated flow fields, a rotatable globe, projection switching, altitude/time controls, and multiple physical-data overlays in one continuous spatial model.
notes: Direct inspection confirms selectable wind/ocean/chemistry/particulate/space/bio modes, animated flow, height and overlay controls, multiple map projections, time navigation, and gridded meteorological sources.

decision.rationale: Adds a canonical scientific-visualization reference for combining vector flow, scalar overlays, globe navigation, and multiple data dimensions without fragmenting them into separate charts.
